headline: Maghen Capital S.p.A. Completes Acquisition of Property on Via Amedei in Milan
summary: Maghen Capital S.p.A. has completed the acquisition of a property on Via Amedei in Milan. Its CEO said the deal strengthens the company's ground-up real estate positioning in the Prime and Hotellerie segments.
why: Real estate acquisitions by investment firms reflect capital flows into prime urban property and hospitality assets in Italy's financial capital.
